def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate a solid separator, whether it is vertical or horizontal.
    col = next((c for c in range(w)
                if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)
    if col is not None:
        a = [row[:col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[col + 1:] for row in grid]
        aw, bw = len(a[0]), len(b[0])
        ca = Counter(v for row in a for v in row)
        cb = Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
        common = set(ca) & set(cb)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda v: (ca[v] + cb[v], ca[v], -v))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == bg and b[r][c] == bg else bg
                 for c in range(min(aw, bw))] for r in range(h)]

    row = next((r for r in range(h)
                if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])), None)
    if row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:row], grid[row + 1:]

        cb = Counter(v for line in bottom for v in line)
        common = set(ct) & set(cb)

            return [[3 if top[r][c] == bg and bottom[r][c] == bg else bg

        bg = ct.most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if v != bg else bg for line in top for v in [line]][0]
                for line in top]

    return [row[:] for row in grid]
